title: New professions and missing entry routes
question: If new occupations become visible through market demand before education or licensing pathways are established, how do people enter them?
test: Verify training provision, occupation standards, recruitment records, and dated practitioner accounts.

title: Funding systems and their access costs
question: Could application requirements, financial preparation, and service fees exclude some of the people a support program is meant to reach?
test: Compare eligibility criteria, application completion, pricing, applicant types, and declines.

title: Continuity after the first opportunity
question: Do first commissions, grants and short programmes lead to continuing income, repeat clients, and sustainable operating arrangements?
test: Longitudinal follow-up, contracting and payment records, and repeat engagement data.

title: Local production and supplier information
question: Does better visibility of suppliers and facilities reduce barriers to making and delivering design locally?
test: Supplier mapping, price comparison, production capacity and user outcomes.

title: Measurement and professional classification
origin_period: 2024 to 2026 archival context; public ministry report
question: How might measurement systems miss people whose creative occupation or contribution falls outside the categories used by a survey?
test: Review GASTAT definitions, labor categories, establishment surveys and primary interviews.

title: The distance between investment and access
question: Can reported financial expansion coexist with persistent barriers for particular applicants, disciplines, or regions?
test: Application denominators, rejected applications, geographical records and follow-up outcomes.
